Findings.Problem: VM02 depends on VM01, the stored WAV contract, but its own notes say the PCM frame contract must stay independent of WAV. The only thing it really needs from VM01 is the sample format: 16 kHz, 16-bit, mono. That makes the dependency look tighter than it is and could lead an implementer to couple the two.
Findings.RequiredOutcome: State that VM02 uses only VM01's sample-format parameters, or depend on a narrower format decision, so the frame layer does not take on any WAV or attachment concepts.

Findings.Section: Manual acceptance plan / Android physical devices
Findings.Problem: The plan says to test 'Android 8 and a current supported Android version'. The manifest sets minSdkVersion=26 (Android 8.0) and targetSdkVersion=34, so the lower bound matches. The plan does not name the target-SDK device, and it does not mention the Android 14 microphone privacy indicator or checking that the foreground-service type is not needed while nothing records in the background.
Findings.RequiredOutcome: Optionally name an API 34 device as the current-version test target and add a check that recording happens only in the foreground and needs no microphone foreground-service type.

Verifications.Rationale: plan-v004 adds an 'R2 deferred call roadmap' table with R2-01 (authenticated call control), R2-02 (live voice call) and R2-03 (video call). Each has a platform, Deferred status, dependencies, a scope boundary and entry acceptance criteria. The plan also adds R2 design constraints, a required order (R2-01 before R2-02 before R2-03), related risks, the VT11 architecture-boundary test, completion gates 11/13/14, and delivery-sequence steps 6-7.
